user.title: Pick your PAX Momento
user.description: Bluetooth devices your adapters and proxies can hear, likely heaters first. If you're not sure which one it is, the heater's is usually the strongest signal near the bathroom.

pair.title: Put the heater in pairing mode
pair.description:
1. Press the button on the heater about **7 times**, until the light turns **green**, then **blue**.
2. While it's blue, press **Submit**.

The presses also switch the heater on and off; that's fine.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair the heater again
reauth_confirm.description:
The heater no longer accepts the saved PIN.

1. Press the button on the heater about **7 times**, until the light turns **green**, then **blue**.
2. While it's blue, press **Submit**.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range, and that the PAX app isn't connected to it.
error.not_in_pairing_mode: The heater isn't in pairing mode. Press its button until the light goes green then blue, and submit while it's blue.
error.not_momento: That device isn't a PAX Momento.
error.pin_rejected: The heater rejected its PIN. Put it in pairing mode again and retry.

abort.no_devices_found: No Bluetooth devices found. Check an adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy is in range of the heater.

not_found.message: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy can hear the heater at {address}.

pin_rejected.message: The heater rejected the saved PIN.

cannot_plan_boost.message: Can't schedule heating for that duration: {error}

started_at_heater.message: The heater was switched on with its button. Switching it off from Home Assistant only stops heating that Home Assistant started; press the button on the heater instead.

start_or_extend.name: Start or extend heating
start_or_extend.description: Heats for at least the given time from now. If Home Assistant already has the heater on for longer, that's kept, so it never shortens a run. Good for automations that fire repeatedly, like a humidity sensor noticing a shower.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to heat for from now, up to 12 hours. Defaults to the timer length.
